create_composable_stable_diffusion_pipel: create a ComposableStableDiffusionPipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, unet, and scheduler components
run_text_to_image_generation: run text-to-image generation using ComposableStableDiffusionPipeline with a single prompt string
run_composable_multi_prompt_generation: run composable multi-prompt image generation using pipe|delimited prompts with per-prompt weights
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode text prompts into CLIP text embeddings with optional negative prompt and classifier-free guidance
prepare_denoising_latents: prepare random or provided latents scaled by the scheduler's init_noise_sigma for the denoising loop
